name: smartrtl-desktop-qoder
description: Sets the direction of mixed Urdu/English text in Qoder IDE's AI chat by the formula. One script line in two of Qoder's pages, kept through Qoder's updates by a small extension; fully removable.

scripts.test: node build/bundle.js && node --test test/install.test.cjs test/extension.test.cjs test/page.test.cjs ../../packages/core/test/direction.test.js ../../packages/core/test/frozen.test.js
